name: How much does basement painting usually cost, and what changes the price?

mainEntity.name: How much does basement painting usually cost, and what changes the price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost is driven by square footage, wall condition, prep work, and the type of coating needed for the surface. A basement that only needs cosmetic painting will cost less than one that needs crack repair, stain blocking, masonry primer, or moisture-tolerant products. If you are comparing bids, make sure each estimate includes prep, materials, and cleanup so you can compare value, not just price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Price depends on basement size, wall condition, prep, and the paint system used. Compare estimates line by line so you know what prep, materials, and cleanup are included.
